about_the_game:
Benny Muldoon, Sheriff of the Court, enforcer of the Prince's word. Agent of destruction. Eradicator of the thin-blooded. To Benny, might is right. He is the whole of the law, and the streets of Seattle are his to hold.

The Kindred of Seattle call him Prince Campbell's attack dog.
What happens when the leash that holds him finally snaps?

Experience Seattle's underworld through Sheriff Benny's brutal perspective in this Story Pack.
Contains new playable story content, combat mechanics, and Phyre outfit.

content_descriptors.notes: This title may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work, like frequent violence or gore.
